heading: Repealed. Aug. 13, 1946, ch. 957, title XI, § 1132, 60 Stat. 1040

notes.text: Section, act Mar. 2, 1921, ch. 113, 41 Stat. 1215, related to acceptance of gifts of lands, buildings, etc., for use of the Service.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective three months after Aug. 13, 1946, see act Aug. 13, 1946, ch. 957, title XI, § 1141, 60 Stat. 1040.
